How to Install on Another Android Phone

  1. Open this page in Chrome on your Android device and tap Download Android App (.apk).
  2. Tap Open once the download finishes (or find it in your Downloads app).
  3. If Android prompts, enable Allow from this source and tap Install.
  4. Sign in with Google to sync Winners Family School parent contacts and WhatsApp chat history.
